Bn.bar_b_note: A competent naturalistic ember-wolf, but its dark muddy brown fur sits in one low mid-tone against the dark backdrop and lacks the value pop and rim light that carry Palworld creatures.

Wn.bar_b_note: The standing violet storm-wolf is at bar, but in both faint frames it flips into an unreadable black-and-white lump that sits above its shadow, which sinks the finish.

Nq.bar_b_note: Bright, saturated water-drake colour fits the creature board, but the glossy toy-like finish and broken faint-end poses (A crumples upright; B turns belly-up with a washed-out grey tail and a shadow set well below) fall short of shipping polish.

Hb.bar_b_note: A's timber frame with brace, cap and stone footing reads as built, but a lone tall narrow panel in an open field reads more like a door or outhouse, and the flat-shaded boulder and thin hazeless sky stay well under Valheim-class light.

Jh.bar_b_note: The woolly storm-ram with heavy horns and a blue gem matches the owner bar and would sit next to Palworld creatures, though B's faint frames turn it into a tangled, legs-up dark-and-white mess.

Dj.bar_b_note: A well-built, well-grounded naturalistic coyote, but it reads as a stock real-world animal with no Tetherbound markings or type accent, so it has less creature identity than Palworld's cast.

Sj.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder villager in a meadow-green vest and scarf with clear eyes and a clean silhouette, at shipping stylised finish, though his animated-film face is more cartoon than the naturalistic creature line.

Xh.bar_b_note: Looks pixel-identical to Dj: the same well-grounded stock coyote, sunk by its lack of Tetherbound identity rather than by any finish fault.

Bd.bar_b_note: A grounded grey storm-wolf with blue glow lines, but its mid-grey coat nearly matches the grey stage in value and its blue accents are too small to carry it at a glance.

top_changes.change: Fix faint animations so the creature keeps its colour and identity and stays on its shadow: Wn's flip to a black-and-white lump, Jh B's legs-up tangle, Nq A's upright crumple and Nq B's grey tail.

Give the stock-looking canids (Dj/Xh coyote, Bd grey wolf, Bn brown wolf) a Tetherbound identity, with type markings, accent colour and stronger value separation and rim light, as on the owner bar's storm-wolf and ram.
Ship Hb A's timber-frame wall (brace, cap, stone footing), give it visible thickness and a wider wall-section proportion, and replace the flat-shaded boulder beside it.
